scope: Synthetic HTML prototype UI only (index-v6.html + suite-v6.js/css over the unchanged v3.4/v4/v5 files). No OS, CLI, helper, model or file-system behaviour validated.

environment.browser: Chromium via Playwright MCP (isolated page per run, Cache-Control: no-cache)
environment.theme_switch: body.dark toggled per pass (same mechanism as the theme button)
environment.measure: document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth, plus any visible element whose right edge exceeds clientWidth outside a scroll container; open <dialog> checked for its own overflow

overflow_pages.note: clientWidth is viewport minus the 15 px classic scrollbar. The first honest run (before fixes) found overflow at 390/320 px on 13–15 pages caused by the sub-tool strip's min-content width; fixed with minmax(0,1fr) on the workspace grid and main{min-width:0}. A temporary overflow-x:clip on html/body was removed so it could not mask results.

overflow_states.extra: uninstall app variants orphan/edr/portable/codex/git checked at 1440/390/320 × light/dark: 30/30 ok

behaviour_checks.detail: Text “扩展概念” absent on all 21 pages in all 6 passes; legacy .badge.concept removed, plans no longer flagged concept
Top nav 清理/软件/优化/分析/状态 with Alt+1–5; rail 计划/活动/恢复/Agent/AI 诊断/设置 with Alt+6–9, Alt+0, Alt+,; Alt+3→#optimize, Alt+5→#status, Alt+6→#plans, Alt+,→#settings
Win/Mac switch keeps names and order; 回收站↔废纸篓, 资源管理器↔访达; Mac-only hardware controls shown in place as 不可用 on Windows

Stage 1 = app_quit + tool_adapter with estimated leftovers not preauthorised; rescan marks partial; stage 2 preselects only cache/logs (Cursor 5/17, Codex x-cache/x-log); models/state.vscdb/sessions unselected; workspaceStorage shared_owner and anysphere-shared owner_unknown have no checkbox; Codex worktree blocked; registry rows show 先备份; backup-unwritable scenario skips registry rows only
Stuck scenario stops at prompt; 取消卸载 marks remaining steps 未执行 and performs no deletion; force needs a second confirmation
Switching app while stage 1 runs increments the sequence and the old result never renders (GUI-14)

Elevation allowed: applied 2, unchanged 1, skipped 1 (user protected), unavailable 1, attention 1, failed 1; heading 维护未全部完成. Elevation denied: TRIM and image check become skipped (未授权), user-level tasks continue; one batched dialog listing both admin tasks
Searching 注册表优化 shows no task and the MNT-05 explanation
Temperature and fan show 未知 with availability unavailable; disk health permission_required; health score 74 computed over known 85% of weights, weights published
lsass/MsMpEng/CleanManager/vmmem end button disabled with reason; unsigned updater_x64.exe shows 用途未识别 and AI 诊断 entry; ending a process requires per-time confirmation

Tray off by default; enabling registers login item and starts sampling; disabling stops alerts; keep-awake countdown restores on end; clean screen blocks keys, exits on 2 s Esc hold (verified) or 30 s timeout

Context menu on 素材视频.mov offers 移到回收站; Downloads folder rejected (protected descendant 参考资料); root rejected (hard-deny); plan dialog states trash-only, not policy-matchable, needs approval; folder 安装包 result failed (被占用 Setup.exe PID 7720) with retry and no auto-kill
永久删除 disabled until DELETE and the first 4 digest characters both match; result reports observed free space before/after and 至少 X

Cards show known size or 未知/count with observed time; restore points (Win) and local snapshots (Mac) show count + 大小不可得; detail drawers have no trash action; old downloads list sorted by size with nothing preselected

First Tab lands on skip link; checkbox Space toggle keeps focus after re-render (data-f restore); sub-tool Enter navigates and keeps focus; details/summary toggles with Enter; native dialog takes focus and closes on Esc; visible focus outline
